file:clawp.py.name: clawp.py
file:clawp.py.summary: Single-file CLI `clawp`: a subscription-billed drop-in for `claude -p`. `main()` parses `clawp [flags] [prompt]` (prompt from arg or stdin) with no subcommands; `run_print_turn()` launches the interactive `claude` TUI in an ephemeral tmux pane via `ensure_session()` (with `--session-id <uuid>` or `--resume`), `send_text()`s the prompt verbatim (no injection), then tails Claude Code's transcript jsonl to capture the answer. A localized transcript-parser section (`find_transcript` glob-by-uuid, `read_records`, `assistant_text`, `final_answer`, `stream_event`, `TERMINAL_STOP`/`CONTINUATION_STOP`/`NOISE_TYPES`) holds all jsonl-schema knowledge; `scrape_reply()` is the schema-break fallback. Dual-signal completion (terminal stop_reason or screen-idle backstop), blocked/stall via screen helpers, `_log_turn()` to sqlite on every exit path, `--history` viewer. Never calls `claude -p`. Stdlib only.

file:test_clawp.py.name: test_clawp.py
file:test_clawp.py.summary: Plain assert-based test script (no framework) for clawp's pure helpers: screen parsing (`has_spinner`/`looks_blocked`/`at_idle_prompt`/`scrape_reply`), the transcript parser (terminal vs continuation stop_reason, noise/compaction skipping, thinking-block exclusion, `final_answer`, `stream_event` ordering), and `claude_version`. Uses inline dict/record fixtures mirroring real transcript shapes. Run with `python3 test_clawp.py`; no live claude needed.

file:README.md.name: README.md
file:README.md.summary: End-user docs for clawp: rationale (subscription vs Agent SDK credit billing), requirements (claude, tmux, python3), single-file install (`ln -s clawp.py`), usage as a `claude -p` drop-in (`clawp "prompt"`, stdin, `--output-format json/stream-json`, `--resume`, `--history`), how-it-works (transcript capture, verbatim prompt, no scratch file), stored sqlite columns, limitations, roadmap. MIT.

file:CLAUDE.md.name: CLAUDE.md
file:CLAUDE.md.summary: Agent guidance for clawp. Leads with why (subscription billing → never `claude -p`; transcript capture instead of scraping), an ASCII architecture diagram of the run_print_turn flow (ephemeral tmux launch → verbatim send → transcript tail → dual-signal completion → sqlite log), exact commands, the CLI surface, forbidden patterns (no `claude -p`, no prompt injection, no typing into dialogs except trust Enter), the localized-transcript-parser coupling rule, conventions, and the project-graph section.

file:docs/clawp-spec.md.name: clawp-spec.md
file:docs/clawp-spec.md.summary: Authoritative design spec for clawp as a drop-in for `claude -p`. Documents the scope revision (clawp IS the drop-in, all legacy removed), goal/non-goals, the verified transcript-jsonl facts (deterministic path, verbatim answer, stop_reason completion taxonomy, incremental flush, resume/compaction append-only, blocked indistinguishability), CLI surface, session lifecycle (ephemeral), output modes, capture algorithm, exit codes, format-coupling posture, and resolved questions. Backed by live Claude Code v2.1.159 runs.

dir:docs.name: docs
dir:docs.summary: Design documentation. Holds `clawp-spec.md`, the authoritative, verification-backed spec for clawp's drop-in-for-`claude -p` design.

dir:..name: claude-wrapper
dir:..summary: `clawp`: a single-file Python tool that makes scripted `claude` usage bill against the Claude subscription instead of the Agent SDK credit pool, by driving the interactive TUI via tmux and capturing replies from Claude Code's transcript jsonl. A subscription-billed drop-in for `claude -p`. `clawp.py` holds all logic (tmux orchestration, transcript parsing, sqlite logging); `test_clawp.py` covers the pure helpers; `docs/clawp-spec.md` is the design spec; `README.md` is end-user docs; `CLAUDE.md` is agent guidance. Stdlib only, no build system.
